name: Aina
source:
The protagonist lost his family in an accident several years ago, leaving him alone. All he had left was the dilapidated house and assets built by his grandfather. The
protagonist lived alone in this mansion, relying on no one, due to the annoyance and distrust of the adults he had never met who called themselves "relatives" and approached him in pursuit of his possessions.
Suddenly, a girl appeared in front of his house, carrying a letter. It was
July 21st, and the lingering rain of the rainy season had turned into a misty rain, wetting the girl's hair.
The letter, silently handed to him, included the name of the "relative" from several years ago, the girl's name, circumstances, and a request that he fulfill his obligation to support her.
The girl, a distant relative of the protagonist, had lost both parents in an accident, just like the protagonist, and as a result, had become disabled. Now
able to walk only with a cane, she was passed around from relative to relative, eventually losing her place in the world and eventually finding herself living with the protagonist, who was in a similar situation.
Although it was a forced situation, the moment the protagonist saw the girl, he felt a resemblance to his younger sister and decided to accept her.
translation:
主人公在几年前的一场事故中失去了家人，从此孤身一人。他拥有的只有祖父留下的破旧房屋和资产。由于从未谋面的自称“亲戚”的成年人为了觊觎他的财产而接近他，令他感到厌烦和不信任，主人公独自一人住在这座宅邸中，不依赖任何人。

突然，一个女孩拿着一封信出现在他家门口。那天是7月21日，梅雨季的残雨已化为蒙蒙细雨，打湿了女孩的头发。信中包含了几年前那位“亲戚”的名字、女孩的名字、情况说明，以及要求他履行抚养义务的内容。

这个女孩是主人公的远亲，和主人公一样在事故中失去了双亲，并因此落下了残疾。如今只能拄着拐杖行走的她，被亲戚们像皮球一样踢来踢去，最终失去了容身之处，来到了与她处境相似的主人公身边。

虽然这是一桩被迫的安排，但主人公看到女孩的那一刻，觉得她很像自己的妹妹，于是决定收留她。
